summary: Unified in-memory rate-limiting plugin on `:server` covering all 5 scopes of §6.10 (`/public/*`, authenticated private routes, `/auth/google`, `/auth/refresh`, and file uploads) with bounded memory (`-Xmx256m`), trusted `127.0.0.1` `X-Forwarded-For` IP resolution, and `429 rate_limited` + `Retry-After`. **Server only**.
overview:
Unifies and completes request throttling across the entire API so a single consistent mechanism protects auth, public routes, private routes, and heavy multipart uploads without external Redis.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §6.3, §6.10, §8 (NFR-01 `-Xmx256m`).

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-server-infra` (`TrustedProxy.resolvedClientIp()`, `ErrorHandling` `ApiErrorResponse`).
- `platform-server-auth` (`AuthPrincipal.userId` + existing auth limits to unify under this plugin).

**Scopes (§6.10)**
- `public` (`/api/v1/public/*` + anonymous `/api/v1/files/*`): **120 req / min** per client IP.
- `private` (authenticated `/api/v1/*` routes): **300 req / min** per `userId`.
- `auth-google` (`POST /api/v1/auth/google`): **20 req / 15 min** per client IP.
- `auth-refresh` (`POST /api/v1/auth/refresh`): **60 req / min** per client IP.
- `upload` (multipart file upload routes: avatars, event image/gallery, inventory/group/achievement/figure images, `POST /documents`): **30 req / min** per `userId`.

**Memory & testability rules**
- Bounded bucket map (max 10 000 entries per scope with periodic stale-entry eviction every 5 min) so IP-flood traffic cannot exhaust `-Xmx256m` heap.
- Inject `Clock` / `TimeSource` and `rateLimitingEnabled: Boolean` in `EnvConfig` (default `true`; tests can toggle or inject a fake clock for deterministic assertions without `delay()`).
- On limit exceeded: respond `429 Too Many Requests` with `Retry-After: <seconds>` header and §6.3 JSON body `{"error":{"code":"rate_limited","message":"Massa peticions. Torna-ho a provar en uns segons."}}`.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :server:test` passes.
- Deterministic tests with fake clock verify exact thresholds for all 5 scopes, `429 rate_limited` JSON body, `Retry-After` header, and window reset.
- Spoofed `X-Forwarded-For` from a non-loopback peer does not bypass IP limits.
- Auth routes reuse this unified plugin instead of duplicate ad-hoc counters.
shared_ui_policy: No UI in this slice. Server-only middleware.
out_of_scope:
- Distributed Redis / multi-node rate limiting (single VPS process per §2).
- UI error handling (already covered by `ApiErrorResponse` message rendering in `platform-web-shell`).
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.

auth.server: IP-keyed scopes (`public`, `auth-google`, `auth-refresh`) run before authentication using `TrustedProxy.resolvedClientIp()`; user-keyed scopes (`private`, `upload`) run after JWT authentication using `AuthPrincipal.userId`.

components.name: TokenBucketStore
components.usage: Thread-safe sliding-window / token-bucket limiter with injectable `TimeSource`, hard cap of 10 000 keys per scope, and stale-bucket eviction to keep memory bounded under `-Xmx256m`.

components.name: RateLimitPlugin
components.usage: Route-scoped Ktor plugin `withRateLimit(RateLimitScope)` resolving key by IP (`TrustedProxy`) or `AuthPrincipal.userId` and responding `429 rate_limited` + `Retry-After`.
components.notes: Replaces any temporary auth-only limiter from `platform-server-auth`.

components.name: Application.module & AuthRoutes
components.usage: Register `TokenBucketStore` in Koin, schedule eviction coroutine, and wrap `/api/v1/public/*`, authenticated `/api/v1/*`, `/auth/google`, `/auth/refresh`, and upload routes with `withRateLimit(...)`.

structure:
Route scoping for all 5 §6.10 buckets:

```text
/api/health                  → exempt
/api/v1/openapi.yaml, /docs  → public scope (120/min/IP)
/api/v1/public/*             → public scope (120/min/IP)
/api/v1/auth/google          → auth-google scope (20/15min/IP)
/api/v1/auth/refresh         → auth-refresh scope (60/min/IP)
/api/v1/* (authenticated)    → private scope (300/min/userId)
  └─ multipart upload routes → also upload scope (30/min/userId)
```

sections.title: Trusted client IP resolution
sections.description: Always derive IP keys via `TrustedProxy.resolvedClientIp()` from `platform-server-infra`.
sections.behavior: When the direct TCP peer is `127.0.0.1` (Caddy), use the right-most untrusted `X-Forwarded-For` IP; otherwise ignore `X-Forwarded-For` completely and use the socket remote address.

sections.title: Bounded memory & test isolation
sections.description: Each scope caps active keys at 10 000 and evicts idle buckets periodically (every 5 minutes).
sections.behavior: Provide a test constructor / `EnvConfig` switch so unrelated integration tests are not affected by rate limits while dedicated `RateLimitTest` tests exercise every threshold deterministically with a fake clock.

persistence: In-memory only (no SQLite writes for rate limiting).
